about_short_description.short_description: Verbiflow is a platform designed for sales teams, facilitating the capture, management, and automation of sales processes.

product.name: AI Powered CRM
product.description: A platform for sales teams to capture leads, manage pipelines, and automate sales workflows.

product.name: Smarter Prospecting
product.description: A tool to identify ideal prospects and automatically capture and enrich their information and interactions.

product.name: Smart Scheduling & Routing
product.description: A system to route and schedule calls based on customizable workflow criteria like industry, company size, or lead source.

product.name: No Manual Updates
product.description: Automatically captures and records every interaction from first contact to deal closure without manual input.

product.name: Intelligent Automation
product.description: Enables building custom KPIs, gaining pipeline insights, and triggering automations within a unified platform.

product.name: Intelligent Columns
product.description: Provides customizable KPIs and dashboards based on any sales activity aspect for flexible visualization.
